notes.title: UPDATED: Global and Friends Leaderboards Live for all Players
notes.content:
Good Morning Recruits!

The current temperature is 110 degrees.

The Chief Instructor of​ ​Lethal VR​ ​Weapons Training has asked me to inform you of an update which has been released for ​all​ ​Vive Lethal VR Recruits​.

This update adds Global ​and Friends ​Leaderboards into each training Simulation. 

Previous bests will be uploaded automatically.

Your reaction times, quickdraw speed and simulation points will be compared and shared with all Recruits globally.

The update includes the following:
[list]
[*]Previous high scores will be uploaded to the new leaderboards allowing for immediate Global competition
[*]A 'Leaderboard' option will now appear in the Main Menu - Recruits can toggle between Global, Friends and Local leaderboards for each Simulation.
[*]​In 'Settings' ​Recruits can ​select which Leaderboard (Global, Friends or Local) they want displayed on the Simulation Introduction and Results screens.
[*]This update also enhances the Settings to enable players to choose whether they are left or right handed and also to adjust their Gun Angle, a requested feature for expert play.

[/list]

notes.title: Global Leaderboards
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26630230/ae04adb1a57b5799a5041337e8ac8505d6b32152.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Hi recruits![/b][/h1]

We just wanted to thank you for all your support and feedback after the launch of Lethal VR! 
We’ve been listening to all your comments, suggestions and requests in the forums and on our social channels, and I’m pleased to announce that we are working on adding global leaderboards! We don’t have a planned release date for the update yet, but it is something we are working on, so keep your eyes open for more information on the forums and news page in the future.

[b]Keep training hard recruits, and thank you again![/b]
